meta.purpose: Registry for story flags used by Chinese content. Keep this file updated whenever a scene sets, requires, or blocks a flag.

statusGuide.active: Flag is set and already used by a later scene or ending condition.
statusGuide.seed: Flag is set now and intentionally saved for future payoff.
statusGuide.planned: Flag is referenced by an ending or future branch but not set yet.
statusGuide.draft: Temporary authoring marker that should be removed or replaced before release.

flags.label: 注意到早期线索
flags.description: 玩家主动追问报纸上的异常失踪案。
flags.plannedUse: Act 2 can unlock faster recognition of infected behavior, safer route choices, or extra dialogue with informed survivors.

flags.label: 忽略早期线索
flags.description: 玩家把早期失踪案当成普通新闻处理。
flags.plannedUse: Act 2 can make the first outbreak response slower or block some early-preparation dialogue.

flags.label: 处理过伤口
flags.description: 玩家认真消毒了手指伤口。
flags.plannedUse: Later medical scenes can reduce infection risk or unlock credibility with clinic characters.

flags.label: 具备基础急救判断
flags.description: 玩家展现出基础急救意识。
flags.plannedUse: Use for medical choices throughout Acts 2-3, especially clinic and wound-treatment branches.

flags.label: 查阅失踪案资料
flags.description: 玩家利用断网前的时间调查失踪案位置。
flags.plannedUse: Can later support city-route choices, outbreak-pattern recognition, and radio/safe-zone skepticism.

flags.label: 购买加厚铁板
flags.description: 玩家选择了重防御准备路线。
flags.plannedUse: Use as a narrative memory flag for later home-base upgrades or others recognizing the fortified door.

flags.label: 提醒五金店老板
flags.description: 玩家提醒五金店老板多囤货。
flags.plannedUse: Can return as a merchant/survivor relationship, a later rescue, or a trust modifier.

flags.label: 选择陷阱策略
flags.description: 玩家购买铁丝网和强力胶，偏向陷阱与迟滞敌人。
flags.plannedUse: Use for later trap-building, ambush, stealth, or militia tactical dialogue.

flags.label: 掌握咬人事件位置
flags.description: 玩家从早餐店打听到异常事件的具体位置。
flags.plannedUse: Can support route-planning and early recognition of danger clusters.

flags.label: 完成充电准备
flags.description: 玩家在断网断电前给设备充电。
flags.plannedUse: Use for flashlight, phone, radio recording, or nighttime navigation options in Act 2.

flags.label: 清点基础物资
flags.description: 玩家在零点前清点水和食物。
flags.plannedUse: Use for rationing choices, morale stability, or group-resource trust in Acts 2-3.

flags.label: 提醒隔壁邻居
flags.description: 玩家冒险提醒邻居堵门窗。
flags.plannedUse: Can grow into a neighbor survivor thread, trust gains, or a costly rescue request.

flags.label: 收到裴嘉应警告
flags.description: 玩家接到裴嘉应关于急诊室失控的电话。
flags.plannedUse: Use to introduce Pei Jiaying's hospital thread, rescue route, or clinic connection.

flags.label: 铁门完成加固
flags.description: 玩家用加厚铁板守住出租屋入口。
flags.plannedUse: Use for home-defense scenes, siege events, or returning to the apartment later.

flags.label: 拥有临时据点
flags.description: 玩家把出租屋暂时变成可防守据点。
flags.plannedUse: Can branch into stay-in-city survival and later shelter-building progress.

flags.label: 楼道陷阱生效
flags.description: 玩家在楼道设置铁丝陷阱并拖住第一波感染者。
flags.plannedUse: Use for future stealth/tactical reputation, or consequences if neighbors discover the trap.

flags.label: 零点制造噪音
flags.description: 陷阱制造巨大声响，可能吸引更多感染者。
flags.plannedUse: Use to increase pressure in nearby streets or trigger a pursuit scene.

flags.label: 提前离开住处
flags.description: 玩家在楼道彻底堵死前离开出租屋。
flags.plannedUse: Use to close home-base options but open mobile/scout routes.

flags.label: 理解感染扩散模式
flags.description: 玩家把早期地点串联起来，理解危险正在扩散。
flags.plannedUse: Use for avoiding outbreak clusters and advising other survivors.

flags.label: 记住城市路线
flags.description: 玩家掌握可避开危险区域的城市路线。
flags.plannedUse: Use for Act 2 flee-to-suburbs branch and later navigation checks.

flags.label: 简易防线
flags.description: 玩家缺乏专门准备，只能临时顶门。
flags.plannedUse: Use for injury, damaged-door consequences, or forced relocation.

flags.label: 选择留在城内
flags.description: 玩家开始固守或城市搜刮路线。
flags.plannedUse: Use for the Act 2 stay-in-city branch and Day 30 convergence.

flags.label: 开始搜刮物资
flags.description: 玩家主动进入街区搜刮水、食物和药。
flags.plannedUse: Use for supermarket/resource conflict scenes.

flags.label: 查看邻居生还
flags.description: 玩家回头确认被提醒的邻居是否还活着。
flags.plannedUse: Use for neighbor companion, trust chain, or rescue debt.

flags.label: 向郊区撤离
flags.description: 玩家开始向郊区撤离路线。
flags.plannedUse: Use for the Act 2 flee-to-suburbs branch and exposure/stranger encounters.

flags.label: 帮助便利店孩子
flags.description: 玩家用食物安抚并帮助躲在便利店柜台后的孩子。
flags.plannedUse: Use for The Kid thread, morale payoffs, and ending memory.

flags.label: 封住便利店后门
flags.description: 玩家用宽胶带封住破裂后门，减少气味或声音外泄。
flags.plannedUse: Use to reduce pursuit risk or make the store a safer temporary cache.

flags.label: Act 2 草稿边界
flags.description: 当前中文剧情写作边界标记。
flags.plannedUse: Remove this once the next real Act 2 scene is written.

flags.label: 存活满一年
flags.description: 玩家到达 Act 4 结尾并存活。
flags.plannedUse: Set in the final Act 4 convergence scene before ending evaluation.

flags.label: 拥有幸存者团体
flags.description: 玩家不再是独行者，已经被某个团体接纳或领导一组幸存者。
flags.plannedUse: Set through clinic, collective, militia, or community-building routes in Acts 2-3.

flags.label: 建立稳定庇护所
flags.description: 玩家建立或维护了足以支撑结局的长期据点。
flags.plannedUse: Set during Act 3 or Act 4 shelter/community arc.
